issues.body: The revised header and docstring still say this implementation is byte-compatible with the `other five` presence-only copies, and call metrics-alert the `SIXTH` copy. At this PR head, the same three-argument, two-tuple, presence-only implementation also exists in `scripts/ledger-identity-watch.py` and `scripts/ratelimit-alert.py`, in addition to the six sites apparently counted by the note. Thus the tier has at least eight copies. The same false `other five` statement remains in the other two changed headers, so a future consolidation author can still omit live trust-plane callers while believing the inventory is exhaustive.

issues.title: The six-copy presence-only inventory still omits two live implementations

verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

The round-2 major finding remains unresolved. The changed notes still describe an exhaustive six-copy presence-only tier, but the PR-head tree contains eight matching three-argument, two-tuple presence-only implementations: the six apparently intended copies plus `scripts/ledger-identity-watch.py` and `scripts/ratelimit-alert.py`. Because the same material inventory error remains at the same severity, progress is stagnant.
